objective: Secure a Korean-history real postal-road / old-road LineString (original line coordinates), or a redistributable genuinely georeferenced historical map of the Korean peninsula.
completionNote: The investigation itself is finished and a documented negative was reached, but the primary objective (securing one usable resource) was NOT achieved. No record has integrationReady=true. Setting completed=false to avoid a false completion.
toolLimits: File tools were confined to the working directory, so C:\Users\gkfkd\Git\sigong-yeojido could not be read at all (tool message: '--restricted confines the file tools to the working directory'). No repository context informed this research.
Only WebSearch/WebFetch/Read/Write were used. No terminal, no browser window, no institutional contact was made.
No proxy, no user-agent change, no alternative-API workaround. Bot-verification walls, 403s and HTTPS-only fetching were left as-is.

records.primaryPublisher: Journal of Computer Applications in Archaeology (CAA International / Ubiquity Press)
records.exactTitle: 'Benefit Maximizing Routes': Development and Evaluation Using the Historical Roads of Korea's Joseon Dynasty (1392–1910)
records.checkedContent: Article page fetched and read directly. Authors: Woo Jin Shim, Ilhong Ko, Soo Jin Park; published 19 Aug 2022; DOI 10.5334/jcaa.97. The paper evaluates modelled routes against historically established Joseon routes. There is NO Data Accessibility Statement, NO supplementary file section and NO GIS attachment on the article page. Documentary sources named for the historical routes: Yeojidoseo (輿地圖書), Daedongjiji (大東地志), Kim (2004), plus vector data obtained from an Academy of Korean Studies 2014–2017 reconstruction project.
records.shortQuote: were fortunate enough to obtain vector data for eight of the Main Roads
records.licenseEvidence: Article page displays 'CC BY 4.0' (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International). This covers the article text only; the third-party Joseon Main Road vectors are not covered and are not distributed with the article.
records.uncertainty: The route vectors are third-party and unpublished, so their provenance, accuracy and redistribution terms are unknown from this source. The paper's own stated limitation is that both HPMS routes and slope-based least-cost paths are less reliable in non-mountainous terrain due to DEM error and resolution.

records.exactTitle: Digital reconstruction and representation of the Sino-Korean Tribute Routes using Geographic Information Systems
records.checkedContent: Article body read directly after following Nature's own idp.nature.com cookie redirect chain back to the article URL. Authors: Liquan Gong, Kelly Greenop, Cathy Keys, Chris Landorf; published 13 May 2025. The Data availability section lists ONLY base maps and environmental inputs (Mappi.net political map, Harvard-Yenching IIIF manifest, Wikimedia Commons relief map, ALOS 12.5 m DEM, China Land Cover Dataset, ERA5-Land, OpenStreetMap). No shapefile, GeoJSON or KML of the reconstructed route is deposited. The reconstructed segment is the ~210 km 'Liaodong Eight Courier Stations' section from Jiuliancheng to Liaoyang in Liaoning, China; Seoul is named only as the routes' origin and the Korean-peninsula portion is not reconstructed.
records.shortQuote: Terrain and environmental data used are derived from modern geographical information, which may differ from actual Qing Dynasty conditions
records.licenseEvidence: Not confirmed. No verbatim licence statement was present in the page body returned to the tool, so the CC status was NOT verified and must not be assumed.
records.uncertainty: No route geometry is published at all. Even if geometry were obtained, the reconstructed extent lies in Liaoning, China, i.e. outside the Korean peninsula requirement. Authors also state that >1000 tribute missions took divergent paths, so one line cannot represent individual trajectories.

records.primaryPublisher: 국가유산청 (Korea Heritage Service), via 공공데이터포털 data.go.kr
records.checkedContent: data.go.kr dataset page read directly: 제공기관 국가유산청, 확장자 SHP, 이용허락범위 '제한 없음', 등록일 2021-09-23, 수정일 2025-06-26, 키워드 문화유산·국가유산·공간·GIS·공간 정보 서비스·위치정보, 제공형태 기관 자체 다운로드. The download page https://gis-heritage.go.kr/newMain/heritageDownload.do was also read directly: it offers 지정유산 공간정보 and 현상변경허용기준 공간정보, coordinate system UTM-K (WMS example EPSG:9020203), categories 국보·보물·사적·명승·천연기념물·국가무형유산·국가민속문화유산·등록문화유산, and carries a 공공누리(KOGL) notice. The content is heritage designated-AREA geometry, not road centrelines.
records.shortQuote: 문화재 공간 정보 서비스는 문화재 정보와 지도 정보가 결합한 공간 정보 활용체계입니다
records.licenseEvidence: data.go.kr page states 이용허락범위 '제한 없음'. The gis-heritage.go.kr download page displays the 공공저작물 자유이용허락표시기준(공공누리, KOGL) marking, but the specific 유형 number applying to the SHP download was not shown on the page I read.
records.period: Not a period dataset. It is a current-status designation layer; the historical date of each 명승 옛길 (e.g. 문경새재, opened 1414) lives in the heritage description text, not in the spatial file.
records.uncertainty: Geometry is designated-zone polygons, not a 역로 network of lines. Only a handful of 옛길 are covered as 명승, and a protection-zone boundary is not the road centreline. The provider states no reconstruction method or limits. Actual geometry type, CRS and item list could not be verified because the file cannot be downloaded and opened with the available tools.

records.primaryPublisher: 국가유산청 (Korea Heritage Service), via 공공데이터포털 data.go.kr
records.checkedContent: Dataset page read directly: 제공기관 국가유산청, 확장자 SHP, 이용허락범위 '제한 없음', 등록일 2025-09-04, 수정일 2025-09-22, 제공형태 '기관자체에서 다운로드(제공데이터URL기재)', download link identical to the sibling dataset. Description mentions 문화재·사적지·명승지 as included categories. Geometry type (점/선/면) and coordinate system are NOT stated on the page; 옛길 is not mentioned as a category.
records.shortQuote: 대한민국 전역에 걸쳐 지정된 국가유산의 위치 정보를 지도 기반으로 제공하는 개방형 데이터
records.licenseEvidence: data.go.kr page states 이용허락범위 '제한 없음'; no explicit 공공누리 유형 number is displayed on this dataset page.
records.period: Not a period dataset (current designation status, file dated 2025-08-31).
records.uncertainty: Same as the sibling dataset: designation locations/areas, not historical route lines. No period or reconstruction-limit statement. File contents unverified.

records.exactTitle: Zenodo REST API record search: "historical road" OR "historical routes" Korea (size=20)
records.checkedContent: 17 records returned and reviewed one by one. None is a Korean historical road/route geospatial dataset. Closest thematic hits were Malatya-Hekimhan (Turkey) historical road network, Safranbolu (Turkey) road network from Western historical maps, Voronezh (Russia) historical routes, and a Tokyo street point cloud. The rest were false positives on the author surname 'Korea'. A parallel OSF/figshare search for a deposit of the Joseon Main Road vectors also returned nothing.
records.shortQuote: No records describe shapefile, GeoJSON, or GPKG formats about Korean historical roads
records.licenseEvidence: Not applicable - nothing relevant found. (The unrelated records were mostly CC-BY-4.0.)
records.uncertainty: This is a genuine absence for this query, not an access block. A differently-worded Korean-language query might surface something, but Zenodo metadata for such a deposit would almost certainly carry the English words searched.

records.checkedContent: Search results read directly. Five datasets: 경상북도 문경시_옛길박물관 전시물현황 (CSV/JSON/XML, museum inventory); 대구광역시 북구_관광지도 (PDF); 대구광역시 북구_관광코스정보 (CSV/JSON/XML, tourist course text); 산림청_국가숲길 노선도 데이터(속리산둘레길) (SHP, but a present-day forest trail, not a historic road); 한국문화원연합회_'성과 옛도로와 지역이야기' (CSV, 연계데이터, narrative text). None contains historical route line geometry.
records.licenseEvidence: Not evaluated per dataset - none of the results met the content requirement, so licence checking was not pursued.
records.uncertainty: The only SHP result is a modern forest trail; using it would be exactly the 'substitute a modern road' failure mode the task forbids, so it was rejected rather than licence-checked.

records.primaryPublisher: David Rumsey Map Collection, David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford Libraries
records.exactTitle: David Rumsey Historical Map Collection — About / copyright and licensing page (www.davidrumsey.com/about). Note: the page's exact <title> string was not captured by the fetch, so this is a descriptive label, not a verbatim title.
records.checkedContent: Copyright/licensing page read directly. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0. Non-commercial reproduction permitted in print or digital with the credit line 'David Rumsey Map Collection, David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford Libraries'. Commercial republication requires permission via carto@davidrumsey.com. Scans are 300–800 ppi; Georeferencer v4 is referenced. The page does not discuss IIIF or GeoTIFF export terms. CRITICAL GAP: the Korea catalogue browse (LUNA) returned a 'Verify Access' bot-verification screen and davidrumsey.georeferencer.com returned HTTP 403, so no specific georeferenced Korea map sheet was confirmed to exist.
records.shortQuote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons License. By downloading any images from this site, you agree to the terms
records.licenseEvidence: Directly read on the About page: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 with the stated attribution string and the commercial-use carve-out. This is a licence for the collection generally; it was NOT verified against any individual Korea item record.
records.period: Not determined — no Korea item record could be opened.
records.uncertainty: Everything about the actual Korea holdings is unverified: whether any Korea sheet is georeferenced, its date, whether it depicts routes, and whether the georeference (GCPs) is exportable. The blockers are a bot-verification wall and a 403, both of which were left unbypassed per the rules.

records.exactTitle: Wikimaps Warper — map title search 'korea', warped maps
records.checkedContent: Results page read directly. Exactly 5 warped maps: id 6212 'Shinpo (Sinpo) from Admiralty Chart No 898' (1933, 6 GCPs); id 6211 'Urusan Wan (Ulsan Man) from Admiralty Chart No 898' (1933, 4 GCPs); id 5793 'Japan - Nipon, Kiusiu and Sikok, and part of Korea' (undated, 9 GCPs); id 5714 'Admiralty Chart No 358 Korea Strait' (1962, 14 GCPs); id 5125 'Admiralty Chart No 2347 Japan and part of Korea' (1855, 4 GCPs). All are marine/hydrographic charts covering coastline and anchorages.
records.shortQuote: Admiralty Chart No 2347 Japan and part of Korea
records.licenseEvidence: Not checked per item, because none of the five maps meets the content requirement (no inland road or route depiction).
records.uncertainty: Nautical charts show no 역로 or inland road network, so they cannot serve the goal regardless of licence. MapWarper.net (the other public warper) could not be checked at all: it returned an hCaptcha challenge, which was not bypassed.

conclusionForIntegration: 결론: 좌표가 있는 한반도 역사 역로/옛 도로 LineString은 이번 조사 범위에서 공개·재배포 가능한 형태로 존재하지 않는다. 유일하게 실재가 확인된 조선 8대로 벡터는 미공개 제3자 데이터이며 제공조건을 확인할 수 없었다. Codex는 이 지도 종류를 #57에서 '자료 없음'으로 처리하고, 역참 점 직선 연결이나 현대 도로·현대 둘레길 대체를 하지 않아야 한다.
